confidence_notes: Overall medium. Restaurant anchors come from aggregator snapshots (Numbeo via Expatica, Wise, LifeIndexed, Wizely, Cities Insider) that broadly agree on about 21 to 27 USD for an inexpensive meal and about 100 USD for a three-course dinner for two. Beer and cocktail figures are weaker (Expatistan estimates and an undated SeattleMag piece). Cappuccino rests on a thin Expatistan estimate and a French price site. No reliable 2026 Seattle wine-by-the-glass figure was found, so wine_glass uses about 1.5 times the beer anchor; a Four Seasons in-room list was excluded as a luxury outlier. Restaurant anchors exclude sales tax and tip. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season and were not checked against live listings. The FX observation (2026-11-18) was reported in a search result summary that cites RBA exchange-rate data; I did not open the RBA page directly, and no 2026-11-19 observation was found.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city basis was needed for food; Seattle-specific aggregator figures were used directly. Wine glass is derived from the beer anchor because direct local data was weak. Accommodation tiers rely on general knowledge of large US Pacific Northwest city hotel and hostel pricing in July peak season.
